boundaries: The official Federal Register dated edition and stated withdrawal date are distinct from a precise operative hour; acquisition occurred before midnight US Eastern time.
Procurement marketplace launch and reported allocation are distinct from purchase orders, expenditure, delivery, testing or measured protection.
Future participation announcements and participant call accounts establish neither negotiated terms nor implemented outcomes.
Government language versions and SEC raw/server-rendered versions are not independent corroboration. Filing is disclosure, not SEC validation of truth.
A dated manager portfolio position is not purchase cost, realized gain, personal income, a sovereign-capital trace or a policy-linked benefit.
No raw source archives, financial-flow totals, new consequential misconduct allegations or changes to existing beneficiary scores are included.
